Job Objective: Accomplished professional with a proven track record in managing and optimizing complex network infrastructures. Skilled in designing, implementing, and troubleshooting network services and security solutions, ensuring efficient connectivity, enhanced performance, and client satisfaction across diverse environments.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Network Engineering

Network Design & Implementation

MPLS (Multi-Protocol Label Switching)

High Availability Protocols

Network Troubleshooting & Issue Resolution

Incident Management & RCA Preparation

IP Routing & Switching

Network Security & VPN Solutions

Service Level Agreement (SLA) Management

Network Monitoring & Reporting

Technical Documentation & Reporting

SOFT SKILLS

Team Leadership & Critical thinking

Observant & Team Player

Analytical & Collaboration

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Computer

Applications (BCA) from Jai Narain Vyas University, Jodhpur, Rajasthan in 2015

Bharat Kumar

+91 7426877673

bkumarsuthar01@gmail.com

PROFILE SUMMARY

▶ Experienced Network Engineer with over 7.4 years of hands-on expertise in managing, configuring, and supporting complex network infrastructures, delivering optimal network performance and ensuring seamless connectivity.

▶ Proficient in working with industry-leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, and Alcatel, leveraging advanced tools and technologies to troubleshoot and resolve network issues promptly.

▶ Strong background in implementing and maintaining critical network services, including Static Routing, BGP, MPLS, NAT, PAT, and VPN technologies, with a proven track record of enhancing service quality for clients.

▶ In-depth knowledge of data center migration, network topology design, and utilizing

advanced protocols for network routing, security, and performance optimization.

▶ Highly skilled in stakeholder management, working closely with both internal teams and external clients to manage service level agreements (SLAs) and ensure alignment with customer expectations.

▶ Strong communicator, able to manage client queries, participate in troubleshooting calls, and

ensure consistent follow-up on escalated cases to guarantee timely resolution.

▶ Well-versed in ticketing systems and coordinating with vendors and engineers to ensure swift

problem resolution, including the use of TAC cases for complex technical issues.

▶ Demonstrated leadership and teamwork capabilities, with a track record of supporting process and service improvements within teams and implementing innovative solutions to meet organizational goals.

WORK EXPERIENCE

Juniper Networks, Bangalore

July 2025 – Present

Technical Support Engineer - 2

▶ Providing technical support for Juniper MX, PTX, ACX series products. ▶ Good understanding Packet level of IP packet flow, OSI layers. ▶ Troubleshoot complicated hardware & software issue, replicate customer environments

and network problems in LAB.

▶ Managing critical customer escalations and providing timely resolutions of the problem

reported and understand the environment/network and impact on business.

▶ Troubleshooting, implementing and supporting of large IP networks. ▶ Configuring and troubleshooting of Layer 3 technologies (ICMP, TCP, IPsec, GRE, Qos,

VRRP)

▶ Configuring and troubleshooting of IP routing protocol (BGP, OSPF, ISIS). ▶ Layer 2 technologies (Ethernet, 802.1q/p VLAN, STP, RSTP, ARP, LACP. ▶ Providing support on MPLS, VPLS, L2 and L3 VPN, MPLS traffic engineering, LDP, RSVP ▶ Taking ownership for problem resolutions and join troubleshooting call with customers. ▶ Participate in cross functional tasks such as new product development projects, create

knowledge base.

London Stock Exchange Group, Bangalore

Growth Path: Network Implementation Engineer (Jan 2023 – July 2025) | On-roll Employee Network Engineer (June 2022 - Dec 2022) | Contract Role via Spigot Software Private Limited

▶ Led data center relocation activities to ensure smooth transitions. ▶ ▶ Worked on various site types, including resilient, non-resilient and split site architectures and configure the router accordingly. ▶ Hands on experience with Cisco ASR9K, Cisco NCS5700 router, Juniper EX9208 (Ethernet switch), SRX550M, SRX380, SRX1500, Cisco

Implemented configurations of BGP, BFD, MPLS, PE-CE Routing, VRF, Static Routing, on Cisco and Juniper devices.

ASA 5545 Firewall and Cisco Nexus9K, Juniper EX4550, QFX5110, QFX5120 switches.

▶ Designed network topologies L2, L3 layer using Visio to visually represent infrastructure layouts. ▶ Supported hardware swap activity from Juniper SRX550 to SRX380 and EX4550 to QFX5110. ▶ Led the configuration of VPN tunnels for secure peer-to-peer communications for some client where dedicated leased line

connectivity is not possible.

▶ Collaborated with clients to discuss design details and configured solutions to meet their specific requirements. ▶ ▶ Configured SNAT, PAT on Juniper and Cisco devices. ▶ Configured Qos on routers and switches. ▶

Involved in SDNET Project, Migrating clients from Sigma network to SDNET platform.

Implemented configuration of live/live and activity/standby setup. Implemented redundancy protocol HSRP/ VRRP.

▶ ▶ Performed failover activity for primary and secondary setup. ▶ Participated in troubleshooting calls with clients for reachability issue. ▶ Enhanced ticket management and issue tracking through ServiceNow to reduce service resolution times and ensure quicker problem

resolution for clients.

Tata Communications Limited, Pune

Jun 2021 – Jun 2022

Engineer - Service Assurance

▶ Utilized ticketing tools such as ServiceNow to resolve issues related to link downtime, application errors, and network vulnerabilities. ▶ Took full ownership of escalated cases, ensuring continuous follow-up until resolution. ▶ Collaborated with router vendors to arrange on-site engineer support for troubleshooting router-related issues. ▶ Prepared Root Cause Analysis (RCA) reports as required, outlining issues and solutions. ▶ Compiled and submitted detailed case reports to the Reporting Manager for review. ▶ Raised Technical Assistance Center (TAC) cases with router vendor teams to diagnose and resolve router-related bugs. ▶ Managed router replacement through Return Material Authorization (RMA) procedures when hardware issues were identified. ▶ Conducted troubleshooting for OSPF, BGP, MPLS, ILL links, PE-CE routing, VRRP, NAT, PAT, and worked with devices from Cisco,

Juniper, Alcatel, and Huawei.

▶ Performed traffic migration and testing using BGP attributes. ▶

Implemented AAA services using TACACS+ on cisco devices.

Tata Communications Limited, Pune

Growth Path: Associate Engineer (May 2019 – Jun 2021) | Contract Role via Prompt Personnel Private Limited Associate Engineer (Aug 2018 – Apr 2019) | Contract Role via Lobo Staffing Solutions

▶ Executed customer downtime activities, including parallel shifting, parallel upgrades, CPE router replacements, and bandwidth

upgrades on MPLS and ILL links, while actively participating in MS Teams calls with customers when necessary.

▶ Collaborated with customers to discuss solutions and configured PE and CPE routers for newly installed leased lines and under-

provisioned leased lines based on customer requirements.

▶ Conducted bandwidth testing using iperf and performed failover testing for primary-secondary CPE configurations to ensure network

reliability.

▶ Troubleshot issues related to under-provisioned links, ensuring optimal performance and addressing connectivity concerns. ▶ Validated link configurations, ensuring successful task closure to support seamless revenue generation. ▶ Gained hands-on experience with various vendor routers and switches, including Alcatel, Juniper, Cisco, and Huawei. ▶ Configured and optimized network protocols such as Static Routing, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, ILL links, PE-CE Routing, VRF, VLAN, HSRP,

and VRRP for efficient network management.

▶ Configured HSRP, VRRP to ensure high availability and network redundancy, improving reliability and minimizing downtime. ▶ Configured Dynamic NAT, Static NAT, PAT, ACL on Cisco and Juniper router. ▶ Worked on STP, VLANs and Inter-VLAN routing, EtherChannel.

CERTIFICATIONS

▶ Cisco Certified Specialist in Enterprise SD-WAN Implementation (300-415 ENSDWI) ▶

Juniper Networks Certified Associate (JNCIA-JN0-105)

TRAININGS

▶ Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) – Routing & Switching ▶ Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) – Routing & Switching ▶

Implementing Cisco SD-WAN Solutions (300-415) – Cisco SD-WAN Certification

TECHNICAL SKILLS & TOOLS

▶ Network Protocols & Operations: TCP and OSI Model, TCP & UDP Operations, Routing Protocols: EIGRP, OSPF, ISIS, BGP, Route Filtering: Route Maps, Access-List, Prefix-List, Distribution List, Loop Prevention Mechanisms: Route Tagging and Filtering, Split- Horizon.

▶ High Availability & Redundancy: HSRP, VRRP, GLBP ▶ Network Services & Security: Telnet, HTTPS, SSH, FTP, SNMP, NTP, DHCP (IPv4), SNAT, Dynamic NAT, PAT, Tracking Objects, TACACS+ ▶ Switching Concepts: VLAN, Inter-VLAN routing, STP, RSTP, MSTP, Switch Priority, Port Priority, Path Cost, Portfast, BPDUguard,

BPDUfilter, Loopguard, Rootguard, Errdisable Recovery, CDP, LLDP, EtherChannel.

▶ Enterprise Networking & Services: MPLS (Multi-Protocol Label Switching), ILL (Internet Leased Line) ▶ Networking Devices & Platforms: Cisco ASR9K, Cisco NCS5700, Juniper EX9208, SRX550M, SRX380, SRX1500, Cisco ASA 5545, Cisco Nexus9K, Juniper EX4550, QFX5110, QFX5120, Cisco ISR4331, CSR1101, ASR1001 and Cisco Viptela and Versa SD-WAN, Alcatel 7750 SR, Huawei, Juniper MX, PTX, ACX series products.

PERSONAL DETAILS

Languages

: English & Hindi

Date of Birth

: 23rd October 1994
